title: Rover Mars — MEDA & Mastcam-Z
description: Telemetria ambiental (MEDA) y cobertura de imagenes (Mastcam-Z). Versionado en config/grafana/provisioning/dashboards/rover_telemetry.json — editar este archivo, no solo la UI.

panels.title: Temperatura y presión — MEDA
panels.description: science.meda_silver_readings · temperature_ats_c / pressure_hpa · eje derecho para presión porque sus rangos no son comparables (temp ~-90 a -30°C, presión ~6.5 a 8.5 hPa).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ingestion_utc AS "time",
  temperature_ats_c AS "Temp ATS (°C)",
  pressure_hpa AS "Presión (hPa)"
FROM science.meda_silver_readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(ingestion_utc)
ORDER BY ingestion_utc

panels.title: Cobertura de imágenes por sol
panels.description: science.sol_filter_coverage · resumen fijo por sol, sin filtro de tiempo (no es una serie temporal).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  sol,
  n_images,
  n_left,
  n_right,
  n_filters,
  first_capture,
  last_capture
FROM science.sol_filter_coverage
ORDER BY sol

panels.title: Viento — MEDA
panels.description: science.meda_silver_readings · wind_speed_ms / wind_direction_deg · eje derecho para dirección (0-360°), escala distinta a la velocidad (0-11 m/s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ingestion_utc AS "time",
  wind_speed_ms AS "Viento (m/s)",
  wind_direction_deg AS "Dirección (°)"
FROM science.meda_silver_readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(ingestion_utc)
ORDER BY ingestion_utc

panels.title: Anomalías detectadas
panels.description: science.meda_silver_readings · filas con anomaly_flag = true dentro del rango de tiempo seleccionado.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ingestion_utc AS "time",
  sol,
  anomaly_reason AS "Razón",
  temperature_ats_c AS "Temp ATS (°C)",
  pressure_hpa AS "Presión (hPa)",
  wind_speed_ms AS "Viento (m/s)"
FROM science.meda_silver_readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(ingestion_utc)
  AND anomaly_flag = true
ORDER BY ingestion_utc DESC
